munit:test.name: me-valid-request-is-reserved
munit:test.description: Message expiration: a request that expires in a minute is QUEUED until the consumer runs, then RESERVED

munit:test.name: me-request-expires-while-it-waits
munit:test.description: Message expiration: the consumer checks expiresAt when it takes a request, not when it is queued: one queued with expiresAt already past is accepted (202) and found expired, one with a minute left is reserved in the same run
